title: SOCIAL BIAS FRAMES: Reasoning about Social and Power Implications of Language

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language models (GPT, GPT-2) on their ability to classify if a post targets racial or ethnic groups and to generate the implied stereotypes, measured using F1, BLEU, ROUGE-L, and WMD against the crowdsourced Social Bias Inference Corpus (SBIC).
